World Youth Day is a vibrant and transformative event where young people from all corners of the globe come together in fellowship with the Pope. This gathering serves as a Catholic pilgrimage, a celebration of youth, and a powerful demonstration of the vitality of the universal Church. Join Bishop Denis on this once in a lifetime pilgrimage in South Korea. YOUTH 2000 CHRISTMAS RETREAT 11TH-13TH DECEMBER 2026 Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register: visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland." THE LIVING WELL EXPO 2026 FOR OLDER PEOPLE This Expo will take place on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at the Mount Wolseley Hotel, Tullow, Co Carlow from 9.30am to 1.00pm. This free community event will bring together a wide range of local organisations and services that support older people to live well, stay connected and remain active in their communities. Meet local service providers; Discover community supports; Explore health, wellbeing and active ageing opportunities; Learn about transport, housing, digital skills and more. Free admission - Everyone welcome . The Expo is open to older people, their families, carers, friends and anyone interested in learning more about the services to support positive ageing.
